verdict.rationale: Motion offers multiple AI-driven features (AI Task Manager, AI Project Manager, AI Meeting Notetaker, AI Workflow Builder, AI Search Assistant) that autonomously schedule, prioritize, and manage tasks, which functions as a form of delegation to an embedded AI assistant. However, evidence describes automated background scheduling/alerts rather than an explicit conversational assistant interface where a user issues ad-hoc task requests. Missing for 10: a documented chat/command interface for directly instructing the assistant, and independent hands-on confirmation of delegation workflows beyond marketing copy.
